pages.title: Ending Theme
pages.text: The ending theme of Vectorman (BlueSky Software, 1995) is a short tune of about 33 seconds. The credits of the game can be seen after finishing it and in demo mode.

pages.title: A prize on the cartridge
pages.text: Some North American cartridges of Vectorman, chosen at random, show a special "you win" screen at the end of the game, with a phone number. Players who sent such a cartridge back to Sega of America before July 31, 1996 could win $25,000, one of ten prizes of $10,000 or one of 90 Sega Saturns, says Sega Retro.

pages.title: A sequel
pages.text: Jon Holland, the composer of Vectorman, returned for the sequel Vectorman 2, which came out in 1996, according to Wikipedia.
